title: finding(app-shell): the console mounts dashboards with no refresh handler, so an authored `refreshIntervalSeconds` never starts a timer
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites, class (b), declared and not enforced. `reach:` named real producer: the console Studio metadata form offers `refreshIntervalSeconds` on a dashboard (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx`, zh label 自动刷新, help text "0 means no auto-refresh"), and the console is the consumer that ignores it. Read at objectui `origin/main` `30f912a0d`; runtime NOT MEASURED in a browser. Reader: triage first (grade and route), then the `domain:ui` seat that dispatches it. Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (`session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`) from the objectui#11004 dev report (PR objectui#11059, `out_of_scope_findings`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The sites

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/DashboardView.tsx` renders `DashboardRenderer` with `schema`, `dataSource`, `modalHandler`, `scriptHandlers` and `hideHeaderText`, and no `onRefresh`.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/useDashboardAutoRefresh.ts` arms its interval only when the host passes a refresh handler, so with none the authored period does nothing.
- No other file under `packages/app-shell/src` reads `refreshIntervalSeconds` (a `git grep` finds only the metadata form, its i18n table and their tests).

## Why it matters

An author (or an AI) sets 自动刷新 to 60 seconds in Studio, saves, and the console dashboard never refreshes, with no error: a declared, authorable key that the product surface does not honour.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Enforce or remove: either the console passes a refresh handler that re-reads the dashboard's data in place (the objectui `AGENTS.md` #8 corollary: refresh data, don't rebuild UI), or the key leaves the Studio form until a host honours it. Measure first whether any other host (the page designer preview, a published app page) passes one.

## Dedupe

The 1025 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed (down to #2231), were listed via REST and grepped locally:
- `refreshIntervalSeconds`: 6 hits, objectui#8820 and PR objectui#10995 (the hook's de-duplication), PR objectui#10320, objectui#9736 (closed; TS twins missing mirrored keys), PR objectui#10452, PR objectui#11059 (the source);
- `DashboardView` near `onRefresh`: 1 hit, PR objectui#11059;
- dashboard near auto-refresh: 6 hits, objectui#8290 (closed; the docs table), objectui#8820, objectui#11004 and their PRs, and a seat post;
- lit control `DashboardRenderer`: 33 hits; absent control `qqzz_never_written_token_31337`: 0.

None carries the console's missing handler.
